rationale.overall: A’s slightly steeper background division is closer to the reference’s diagonal composition, while the central forms are otherwise virtually identical.
rationale.material: Both takes use the same dark block shading, warm underglow, soft shadows, and translucent curled strip.
rationale.silhouette: The block and curled-strip silhouettes appear identical in both takes.
rationale.smallsize: A’s diagonal background split remains marginally closer to the reference’s read at reduced sizes.
